craft_notes: Sthāyin: puzzling identity. Device: em-dash→comma (built softens, dream questioned). Identity chain kept literal. Rejected: smoothing — never. Read aloud: lands on close.

lines: Glow-built, troth-true, thou the soul of whom, ev'n he am I,
'worldling,' say: what, lord, this dream, and how in thee?
l4.sanskrit_cite: bhārūpaḥ satyasaṃkalpas tvam ātmā yasya so 'py aham saṃsārīti kim īśaiṣa svapnaḥ so 'pi kutas tvayi
